reasons.reason: The one clear behavior change is the verify rule making Sonnet and Haiku run tests, 30/30 and 27/30 vs 0/30, on one task shape
reasons.why: 30/30 is the preset's rules (R1), not verify alone (29/30 in R3), and R2, R9 and R10 show behavior changes on other tasks.

reasons.reason: Model switches have a known gap: low own-share after /model, an unconfirmed switch note, undeclared auto-switch models get no rules
reasons.why: The 55% figure and the switch details are not in the map, though they are consistent with limits L5 and L8.

false_claims: No quality gain is measured yet (contradicted by R10)
The verify rule is the one clear behavior change and applies to one task shape (contradicted by R2, R9 and R10)
The verify rule alone gave Sonnet 30 of 30 (R3 gives 29 of 30 alone; 30 of 30 is the preset's rules in R1)

judgment.delivery_claim_why: It says each session and subagent receives the rules declared for the model it runs on, through hooks, logged, and explicitly not that the model follows them.

reasons.reason: verify-changes made Sonnet and Haiku run tests after the one-file fix (27-30 of 30 vs 0 of 30) and roughly doubled cost
Sonnet's carry-through changed behavior only on a bug task
reasons.why: R10 credits carry-through's effect to the triage backlog task, and the bug-task result R2 is for the full preset's rules.

reasons.reason: haiku carry-through was not shown to help
reasons.why: R11 says the run did not show it to change anything.

reasons.reason: Opus and Fable rules have no measured correctness effect; those rules were not delivered in the 2026-11-20 experiment
reasons.why: The evidence map does not cover these rules either way.

reasons.reason: Opus sessions would get no rules from this preset until checked
reasons.why: The claude preset includes rules for Opus 5.5, which noonsight delivers.

reasons.reason: Fable's low-context-report shortened sentences, a style effect
reasons.why: R9 shows shorter mean sentence length with the rule on three tasks.

reasons.reason: Subagent handling is the strongest part
reasons.why: Hooks run on SubagentStart, D3 gives 100% subagent coverage, and subagents are a measured advantage.

reasons.reason: It stays out of the way by default: routing and classifier off, rules toggleable, decision log, no network without the classifier
reasons.why: The reference lists each of these as documented behavior.

reasons.reason: The project is early: nothing published, installed from a clone
reasons.why: The reference describes it as pre-release and installed from a clone.

false_claims: Sonnet's carry-through changed behavior only on a bug task (its effect was on the triage backlog task)
Opus sessions would get no rules from this preset until someone checks them (the preset has Opus 5.5 rules)
The experiment had 3 to 30 runs per arm (R10 and R11 have 40 per arm)
